blockingIssues.description: Narrative pair extraction in publication/reconcile_metrics.py is too narrow and skips validating extracted speedup claim text such as 'rust-ag achieved a 2.0× speedup over the original ag', leaving a required narrative claim unvalidated.
publication/reconcile_metrics.py returns early on reconciliation failure before writing publication/reconciliation_report.json, so failing runs can leave stale or missing evidence output.

scripts/bench/build_scenario_manifest.py now always emits '{pattern} {corpus}' for stdin stream scenarios; parity execution then supplies a file argument alongside stdin_data, regressing required stdin-driven stream behavior.

appliedUpdates.description: Added `publication_tests` command for deterministic execution of publication test suite (`python3 -m pytest publication/tests/ -v`).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify whether strict red-first test-first workflow applies uniformly to publication/tooling scripts or only to code paths where practical; align this with current skill procedures to remove contradictory guidance.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both misc-publication-license-audit-transitive-runtime-coverage and misc-publication-reconcile-speedup-claims reviews observed AGENTS test-first requirements not explicitly enforced by publication-worker procedure, creating inconsistent expectations.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update benchmark-worker guidance to explicitly preserve stdin/stream semantics when enforcing scenario-template integrity and comparator completeness.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: misc-cli-stream-manifest-integrity-fix passed comparator/placeholder checks but regressed stdin-driven stream execution semantics.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Broaden rewrite-worker example handoff content to include tooling/manifests/non-Rust feature examples so reporting expectations are explicit beyond Rust parity work.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: misc-skill-guidance-alignment review noted residual Rust-centric handoff examples despite widened rewrite-worker scope.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a dedicated services.yaml command for publication license inventory generation.
